title: Home practical guide and safety card: periscope
subject: Science
source: Written for science/y6 lesson 20 (Home practical guide and safety card: periscope (portal worksheet; adult cuts, plastic mirrors, never at the Sun))
intro: Lesson 20: Designing a periscope. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To design and make a periscope
equipment: A long box or two juice cartons
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: An adult cuts a window at the top front and bottom back
Fix one mirror at 45° at the top, facing down
Fix the other at 45° at the bottom, facing up
Look through the bottom window; never at the Sun
Test it and record how well it works

head: Test
Could I see over? (yes or no)
Improvement

questions.q: Big question: how could two mirrors help a submarine crew see?
questions.a: Light reflects off the top mirror down the tube and off the bottom mirror into the eye.
